validity_rule: A mutant changes exactly one contract-relevant public fact, remains representable by the frozen source/in-memory observation record, and is not equivalent on the P1367 fragment.
score_rule: valid mutants classified Violated divided by valid mutants; Unknown gives zero credit and blocks a 1.0 seal

mutants.change: call flush before write_all
replace write_all with one Write::write call and accept its partial count as success
replace write_all with write_fmt or a formatting macro
omit write_all
write the complete block twice with write_all
fragment the block across two write_all calls
write only block.as_bytes()[1..]
append a newline before writing
trim or replace bytes in the block before writing

public_witness.expected_bytes: exact block.as_bytes including NUL and LF

mutants.change: remove flush after successful write
flush twice after successful write
discard BrokenPipe from write_all and call flush
map BrokenPipe write error to ErrorKind::Other
discard TimedOut flush error and return Ok
map TimedOut flush error to ErrorKind::Other
emit_watch_block writes directly to std::io::stderr without locking
emit_watch_block obtains a lock but drops it before write_watch_block
emit_watch_block invokes write_watch_block twice
emit_watch_block discards Result with let _ and returns normally
retain eprint for Compiling together with emit_watch_block
retain terminal eprint together with emit_watch_block
migrate only one of the two P1366 status callsites
route drain_to_stderr through emit_watch_block
route HTML_EXPERIMENTAL_WARNING through emit_watch_block
exact test calls emit_watch_block and real stderr
exact test launches a watch or w subprocess
split success, write-fail and flush-fail across three test functions
make write_watch_block or emit_watch_block pub or pub(crate)
change status bytes, timestamp, spacing or diagnostic order while adding flush
alter polling, staging, publish, abandon, wait, eviction, another command or another product file

supplemental_attacks.attack: partial write API, fragmented write_all, omitted/duplicated write and byte mutation
flush before write, zero/duplicate flush, flush after write error and swallowed/changed errors
stderr without full lock, duplicate delegation and wrapper that does not fail explicitly
migrate one of two status sites, retain legacy output or route diagnostics
real stderr/process in test, multiple tests, public API and scope creep

determinism.required: same validity, Violated classification, reason and concrete public witness in both orders and repetitions
determinism.state_rule: each mutant is classified from its explicit observation delta only; no prior mutant may affect another

calibration_budget.stop_rule: any survivor or unexpected Unknown blocks seal; two unchanged failed revisions require redesign rather than a third full pass

claim_limit: Mutants exercise only the frozen P1367 write, flush, propagation, wrapper, routing and safety fragment; no isolation attestation, real-terminal behavior or general watch equivalence is claimed.
